stable.headline: Copy parts between scenes and windows, a New window, and Animate that edits several clips at once
notes: Copy parts in one scene and paste them into another scene tab or another window of the app.
Menu › New window opens the app again in a window of its own.
Split meshes by material, and a Tools card with Merge, Decimate, Recentre and Align.
Animate: drag rows into order, edit several clips at once, and nothing plays until you press Play.
Claude can take its pictures in Photo mode, and asks you first.
Fixes for glass hiding what is behind it, gizmo handles that grabbed from too far, and command cards that grew past the top edge.
